response.what_it_is: Industrial stainless steel water filter housing / treatment vessels
visible_condition: factory mounting legs and top/bottom ports attached
hidden_risks: internal filter cartridges or media bags missing
exact pressure and flow rating unverified
completeness of internal piping and distribution headers
weld integrity and pressure test status
response.failure_mode: Mistaking industrial multi-cartridge filter housings for standard domestic water storage tanks or assuming internal filtration elements are included.
